exposure: history of SGA or fetal demise
outcome: Composite Neonatal Outcome (Apgar scores, neonatal death, umbilical cord pH, fetal distress, fetal anemia, fetal hypoglycemia)
cohort: 162 preterm parturients (28 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks) with pre-eclampsia; 81 with oligohydramnios and 81 with normal amniotic fluid index
finding: In preterm pre-eclamptic patients, oligohydramnios is an independent risk factor for early neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The study found that preterm preeclamptic patients with oligohydramnios had more cesarean sections.
